businesses.description: Dataset of public Google Maps businesses collected across the requested geographic grid. Listing mode includes name, categories, address, rating, review count, phone, website, weekly hours, timezone, country, coordinates, place identifiers, and the in-cell rank; detail enrichment adds Plus Code, photo count, photo sample, rating histogram, and observed open/closed status.
